FieldSet.description: ALF-RS-08 (LFRDN-338) FR13, ported onto the LFRDN-342 document-requirements engine. Fields AF_DocumentConditionEvaluator references when evaluating AF_DocumentCondition__mdt rows scoped to AF_VehicleReservation__c via AF_DynamicObject__mdt - contract type, trade-in-as-deposit, and (LFRDN-702) approval status are the dimensions the Required Documents rules vary on. AF_ApprovalStatus__c added so the Approval Reference document rows can require AF_ApprovalStatus__c = 'Approved', not apply to every 7-Day reservation regardless of whether it actually went through manager approval.
FieldSet.label: AF Document Condition Fields
